UPDATE user_yunzhanghu_profiles
            SET sign_status = 'signed',
                sign_url = NULL,
                sign_nonce = NULL,
                signed_at = $3,
                terminated_at = NULL,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE user_id = ANY($1::bigint[])
              AND sign_status = 'signing'
              AND sign_nonce = $2
            RETURNING user_id
